rules.name: The three possible verdicts
No number without the three checks
Grout age is not a diagnostic signal
Moisture reading is read against a dry reference, not alone
Majority-hollow tap test in the wet courses means retile
Greenboard behind tile in the wet zone is a red flag on its own
Put the override in writing when it contradicts the customer's expected verdict
Tap every tile on a floor, not just the stained ones
A grout crack that runs straight across several tiles is structural movement, not a grout problem
Every change of plane gets flexible sealant, never grout — on every job
Zero tolerance: a grouted corner gets redone same day
Cement grout cure and seal timeline
Sealing cement grout too early causes a milky haze
When to use epoxy grout instead of cement
Unsanded grout only for joints an eighth inch or smaller
Never acid wash natural stone
A photo can earn a visit, never a number
Flood test the shower pan before quoting a mud-set floor with staining past the curb
Lead with what you measured, not the price
Always name the cheaper option you rejected, and why, in one sentence
Never promise new grout color will fix mildew
Never give a completion date that omits the 72-hour cure window
Caulk, don't grout, at changes of plane
A straight crack across tiles signals movement, not a grout defect
Wait 72 hours before sealing cement grout
Never use acid on travertine or marble
Check ventilation before treating mildew, and never promise colour fixes it
Flood test before quoting a mud-set shower floor
Never form a verdict before completing the field inspection
Field sheet precedes every quote
Moisture reading locations
Tile-course moisture reading via grout joint
Moisture reading thresholds and required action
Every reading must carry its location
Tap test coverage
Mark hollow tiles on sketch
Hollow tile threshold rules out regrout
Hollow band on floor signals substrate failure
Change of plane inspection points
Grouted change of plane must be replaced with sealant
Flood test trigger for mud-set shower pans
Ventilation check procedure
Mildew on sound grout points to ventilation first
Verdict justification must be reading-based
